errors.text: The proposed grain-refining addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering at 1000 °C.
The grain-refining element, concentration, alloy composition, and processing parameters are unspecified, so the intervention is not experimentally actionable.
No prior experimental evidence or citations support simultaneous improvements in mechanical, corrosion, and oxidation performance.
Predictions are purely qualitative and omit target observables such as relative density, hardness, oxidation rate constants, corrosion potential, and corrosion current density.
The falsification rule uses an undefined 'significant improvement' and supplies no thresholds, replication plan, or explicit electrochemical and oxidation-kinetics criteria.
